Company description:
"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."
Job description:Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
 Your future team
 Are you passionate about developing advanced vehicle technology while bringing people, technical solutions and teams together? At Volvo Group, you will have the opportunity to combine hands-on involvement in ADAS function development with a key role in supporting agile collaboration and successful engineering deliveries.
 You will join the Driver Support Functions team within Volvo Trucks Technology & Industrial Division in Gothenburg. We develop Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) throughout the entire product life cycle, from early concepts and requirements to software development, verification, vehicle integration and product maintenance.
 Our work includes functions such as Intelligent Speed Assist, glare-free lighting, driver distraction, drowsiness warnings and pilot assistance. We work in agile teams, collaborating across engineering disciplines to develop reliable driver support functions for Volvo Group's global truck portfolio.
 We are now looking for an ADAS Function Developer & Scrum Master who combines a strong technical foundation with a holistic perspective and a genuine interest in enabling team collaboration. This is a role for someone who enjoys understanding the technology, connecting different parts of the development process and helping teams move forward together.
  
 What you will do
 In this combined role, you will contribute to the development and delivery of ADAS functions while supporting the team's agile ways of working. You will connect technical development with coordination and collaboration, helping ensure that functions progress from requirements to verified solutions.
 Your responsibilities will include:
  Develop ADAS functions and contribute to end-to-end function development.
 Translate customer, regulatory and system requirements into use cases, software designs and testable solutions.
 Coordinate function development activities and support alignment between software, systems and verification teams.
 Take on Scrum Master responsibilities, facilitating agile ceremonies, supporting planning and helping the team identify and remove impediments.
 Identify and help resolve technical and organizational dependencies, bringing the right people together to overcome obstacles and keep function development moving forward.
 Maintain a holistic view of function deliveries, development roadmaps and dependencies across teams.
 Plan and support verification through simulation, SIL, HIL, test rigs and vehicle testing, analyzing results and resolving issues.
 Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, promote continuous improvement and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
  
 
 Who are you?
 You are a technically grounded engineer who enjoys seeing the bigger picture. You understand how complex vehicle functions are developed and delivered, and you are motivated by both solving technical challenges and helping people work effectively together.
 You are someone who naturally connects the dots, sees dependencies before they become obstacles and takes initiative to bring clarity and alignment when development challenges arise.
 You bring structure to complex situations, communicate clearly across technical disciplines and enjoy facilitating discussions, building alignment and supporting a collaborative team environment.
 We believe that you have:
  A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related field.
 Several years of experience in automotive embedded systems, function development or another safety-critical software domain.
 Hands-on experience in software development using C++
 Experience working across the development life cycle, from requirements and design to implementation, integration and verification.
 A solid understanding of software architecture, interfaces and system behavior.
 Experience working in agile development teams and an interest in taking on Scrum Master responsibilities.
 Strong communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
 Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  
Additional experience that is valuable:
  Previous experience as a Scrum Master or in facilitating agile development teams.
 Experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR or model-based development using MATLAB/Simulink.
 Software quality practices such as clean code, code reviews, static analysis, CI/CD, test automation, ASPICE or MISRA C++.
 Functional safety and safety of the intended functionality, including ISO 26262 and SOTIF.
 AI-assisted engineering, machine learning or data-driven methods for function development, analysis, testing or evaluation.
 Verification using SIL, HIL, test rigs, measurement and calibration tools, vehicle networks or in-vehicle testing.
 Signal processing.
  
 
  
 Ready for the next move?
 Location: Gothenburg, Sweden.
 Last application date: December 1st, 2026.
  
  
 As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.
  
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com
 
Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
 
 
 
Role Summary 
This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden
 
 Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the way of handling new vehicle related legislation. We are responsible for overviewing and handling new legislation, coordinating the Technical Lobbyist network and making valid legislation available in the VW database Getex and also in the product structure OAS. We are part of the Domain Product Compliance within Modular Solutions.
As a member of the Regulatory Affairs section, you will play a key role in handling new vehicle legislation from a global perspective. Working across areas such as Active Safety & ADAS, Digital Product Compliance, Electrification and Circularity, you will coordinate legislation activities across regions and collaborate with stakeholders from R&D, Public Affairs, Product Planning and external organizations.
The role combines leading Regulatory Clusters, evaluating the impact of future legislation on products, supporting technical lobbying activities, and participating in international industry working groups related to vehicle legislation and compliance.
You will be active in some suitable external working groups preferably in the field of Active Safety. Most of our external working group participation is in the global vehicle industry association OICA. This is also very much depending on your back ground and experience. Other working group participation could be discussed depending on your background.

Job Responsibilities
·      Lead (Pilot) the Regulatory Cluster working group for Active Safety & ADAS and provide input to the legal roadmap within these areas.
·      Coordinate legislation-related activities with colleagues across Europe, Brazil, the US and China, including technical lobbyists, type approval engineers and subject matter experts.
·      Drive process development and ensure Regulatory Affairs responsibilities are integrated into TRATON One PDP and Regulatory Affairs processes.
·      Summarize Technical Lobbying Criticality and communicate relevant topics to TRATON Public Affairs when needed.
·      Participate in external technical lobbying working groups, particularly within OICA GEVA and ACEA, focusing on automated, autonomous and connected vehicle regulations, CSMS/SUMS and related legislative developments.
·      Monitor Active Safety and ADAS related regulations across Regulatory Clusters and working groups.
·      Stay informed about company strategy, technology developments and legislative trends to proactively support stakeholders.

Who You Are
 We believe you have:
·      Experience in regulatory affairs topics and participation in external technical lobbying forums.
·      Experience working within a product development process, with strong understanding of requirements management and Type Approval.
·      Ability to transform improvement ideas into practical implementation.
·      Experience evaluating and interpreting vehicle-related legislation.
·      A relevant Engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.
·      A structured way of working combined with high integrity and professionalism.
·      Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
 
This Is Us
 We are a collaborative and skilled Regulatory Affairs section responsible for building the roadmap of upcoming legislation, identifying legal gaps, supporting efficient technical lobbying activities and ensuring vehicle-related legislation is available and accessible throughout TRATON R&D.
We work closely with TRATON Group R&D, our brands, TRATON Public Affairs and TRATON Product Planning. Our mission is to identify legal gaps early, enable proactive product development activities and contribute to the establishment of effective, data-driven vehicle legislation.
 
 Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. 

TRATON Offers 
With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
 
Application
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. 
 
 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
 
 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: 
 Magnus Jalkesten, Head of Regulatory Affairs, magnus.jalkesten@scania.com 
 
 
 We look forward to your application!
 
 This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

Are you ready to take on a role where your financial expertise directly influences global procurement strategy?  
Join us as a Procurement Finance Director and become a key business partner to our procurement organization. In this newly established position, you will help build the financial foundation for procurement excellence, strengthening data-driven decision making, and improving cost competitiveness across a global organization. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, contribute to strategic initiatives, and play a vital role in shaping how procurement performance is measured and developed in the years ahead.
Your responsibilities 
You will partner with the global procurement leadership team and provide financial guidance to support strategic and operational decision-making. 
You will develop, monitor, and improve procurement performance measurements and KPIs, helping the organization turn insights into actions. 
You will lead forecasting and budgeting activities while preparing and enhancing monthly reporting related to procurement costs, purchase volumes, purchase price variance, capacity costs, and DPO.  
You will validate and support procurement savings initiatives, ensuring financial transparency and a strong link between strategy and execution. 
You will collaborate with procurement, production, business area finance teams, and GS Finance colleagues to develop data platforms and increase visibility into procurement performance across the business. 

Expectations for you 
You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or a related field.  
You bring 8-12 years of experience within financial management, supply chain controlling, operations controlling, procurement controlling, or related finance leadership roles.  
You have a strong understanding of accounting principles, excellent analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate analysis into business actions.  
You have experience working with reporting and analytics tools. Knowledge of Power BI, Microsoft 365 applications, and advanced Excel skills are highly valued. 
You have advanced English proficiency and enjoy collaborating with stakeholders across a global environment. 

To succeed in this role 
Success in this position comes from combining strong procurement finance expertise with a business partnering mindset. You are comfortable analyzing complex business cases, developing KPI-driven performance management, and identifying opportunities for improvement through data and insights. You thrive in dynamic environments, show curiosity when facing uncertainty, and enjoy building new ways of working while supporting strategic transformation initiatives.
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer 
This is a unique opportunity to join a growing global finance organization to support the future development of procurement finance capabilities. You will become part of the Global Supply Finance organization and work closely with procurement leadership, production organizations, local controllers, and business controllers across the company. The team is focused on strengthening procurement performance, driving savings initiatives, improving reporting, and building greater transparency through data and analytics. The role offers broad global exposure, close interaction with senior leaders, and the opportunity to make a visible impact on business performance.
At Valmet, you'll work in an international and collaborative environment where development, innovation, and continuous improvement are encouraged. We value our employees and support both personal and professional growth through learning opportunities, modern tools, and flexible ways of working. 
Want to know more? 
For further information about the position, please contact Marc Volmer, Vice President, Finance, Global Supply at marc.volmer@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email. 
If you are interested in becoming part of the team, you can apply by December 8, 2026, by filling in our online application form. 
For positions with people leadership responsibilities in Sweden, delegated Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) responsibilities form an integral part of the role. Relevant information will be shared and discussed during the recruitment process.
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. 
When everything works together 
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.  
At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.  
Join the team – and lead the way with us! 
www.valmet.com/careers

Company description:
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
Job description: Financial Control & Accounting (FCA) is a global finance organization in Group Finance responsible for securing finance and tax compliance, accounting and financial reporting for most Divisions, Business Areas and Group Functions in Volvo Group. FCA also hosts our Finance Global Competence Center providing qualitative, process efficient, automated finance deliveries. We are a truly global organization with around 1400 highly professional colleagues in more than 50 countries, closely integrated with local business operations.
  
 Our mission is to secure accurate and timely financial reporting and compliance with the Volvo Group. We aspire to lead finance and compliance through excellence and innovation.
 We are now recruiting a Director FCA Global Tax Process Owner  
 
 FCA is responsible for tax compliance for a majority of Volvo Group’s legal entities. In the global context FCA operates in, it is important to secure strong tax compliance and efficient tax compliance processes that support Volvo Group. Regulatory developments and major finance and technology transformation initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA and MF2.0, create significant opportunities for further process development, automation and standardization across countries and regions.
  
 Therefore, we have established a new global process owner role with the responsibility to drive our tax compliance optimization agenda, coordinate standardization, digitalization, and efficiency of tax compliance processes within FCA.
  
 You will also directly lead a team of 2 global tax sub-process owners for Pillar 2 and Indirect taxes.
  
 In this role you will be working closely together with colleagues in the Group Tax department as well as with a network of colleagues working with tax compliance processes in FCA and other Volvo organizations. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape and drive our global tax process transformation agenda in a complex, fast-changing regulatory and technology environment.
 Key Responsibilities 
 
  Establish a global roadmap to drive efficiencies through process standardization and digitalization for tax compliance processes in FCA and Volvo Group, in cooperation with Group Tax and other key stakeholders.
 Anchor the roadmap and implementation plans with the Volvo Tax compliance governance bodies and within FCA.  
 Lead a global network of tax compliance experts in FCA to share information and to prepare implementation plans. 
 Collaborate with applicable functional teams to integrate tax compliance process requirements into the S/4Hana finance system
 Support the development of training materials and establish training sessions for end-users. Securing that process documentation is established when required
 Stay updated with the latest changes in tax laws 
  
 
 The position will require close cooperation with other internal functions in FCA and with other functions throughout the Group such as Group Tax, Group Accounting and Business organisations. 
    Profile description:  Who you are 
 
 The ideal candidate will have a solid overall knowledge of taxes including tax compliance processes for direct and indirect taxes.
  
 Leadership experiences including direct people leadership, functional and transformational leadership in a global cross-functional environment are considered as very valuable.
  
 If you are the one we are looking for, you are likely to have a relevant academic degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or a related field, with the following qualifications:  
  
  Very good understanding of business processes in multinational companies
 Experience in process governance, internal controls, data quality and global standardization.
 Very good understanding of SAP or comparable ERP and finance systems 
 Strong analytical, prioritization, decision-making and problem-solving capabilities 
 Proficiency in written and spoken English is required
  
 
 This is a global role and you will work with the tax compliance teams globally. The role will be hosted in FCA Group & Sweden and located in Gothenburg Sweden. In this role you will report to the VP FCA Group & Sweden and be part of the FCA Group & Sweden management team.
  
 Any questions about the position should be raised to Mats Pettersson through e-mail mats.pettersson@volvo.com or phone +46 765536213.
  
 Last application date is December 6th. 
  
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
  
 As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.
 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
 
 
 
 
 
We offer:Group Finance contributes to realizing the vision of the Volvo Group by developing and providing a wide range of expert services from financial planning to accounting, business controlling, M&As, financial reporting and investor relations. With Volvo Group Finance you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

Allocation Controller

Welcome to a role where analysis meets business, customer focus, and commercial impact. As an Allocation Controller at Kappahl, you will play an important role in ensuring that the right products reach the right stores at the right time and in the right quantities. If you are analytical, business-oriented, and motivated by turning data into actions that drive sales and customer experience, we would love to hear from you.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to work in a central commercial role where your analysis directly influences product availability, customer experience and business results. You will join a collaborative environment with the opportunity to contribute both to daily performance and to the continued development of Allocation at Kappahl

The role

You will be part of our Allocation team and work closely with Buying, Planning, Retail, E-commerce and our market organizations. The role combines day-to-day allocation with forward-looking analysis and continuous development. You will have a clear mandate to identify commercial opportunities, recommend actions and follow up the results.

• Plan and execute product allocation across stores and online channels based on demand, sales performance and stock position.

• Analyze sales, availability, sell-through and stock health to identify risks and commercial opportunities.

• Develop and maintain store clusters and allocation parameters that reflect local demand and customer needs.

• Translate insights into clear recommendations and actions for relevant stakeholders.

• Monitor allocation KPIs and evaluate the impact of your decisions.

• Contribute to the development of allocation processes, tools and scalable, data-driven ways of working.

Are you interested?

This is a temporary position for one year due to leave of absence, based at our new head office in Mölndal, with a planned start date as soon as possible.

At Kappahl Group, we believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and has the opportunity to grow and succeed.

Ready to join us? Apply with your CV today – no personal letter is needed. We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than November 30th 2026. We look forward to hearing from you.

Your profile

You have a relevant university degree, or equivalent professional experience, within Economics, Business Administration, Supply Chain or a related field. Previous experience from allocation, merchandise planning, demand planning, business analysis, supply chain or another analytical retail role is valuable.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large data sets in Excel.

• The ability to connect detailed analysis with customer needs and commercial outcomes.

• Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

• Experience with allocation or forecasting tools, clustering methods or BI solutions is an advantage.

• Curiosity about retail, customer behavior, digital development, data analytics and AI.

Who you are

You are analytical, proactive and solution-oriented. You take ownership, communicate clearly and enjoy turning insights into measurable actions. You enjoy collaboration and build strong relationships across functions and markets, and you are comfortable moving between strategic discussions, analytical problem-solving and operational priorities. You have a strong end-to-end perspective and understand how decisions and activities in one part of the business impact the wider value chain, enabling you to identify dependencies and drive outcomes across the entire flow. Most importantly, you recognize yourself in Kappahl’s values: Inclusive, Courageous and Joyful.

The Kappahl Group is a leading fashion chain in the Nordics, with around 350 Kappahl and Newbie stores across Sweden, Norway, Finland, Iceland, Poland and the UK, as well as online sales in more than 20 markets throughout Europe and Asia. Founded in 1953, the Group has grown into an international fashion business with profitable and sustainable growth at the heart of its strategy.

We want to make a difference in the fashion world and to lead the way by always keeping our promises: taking care of the world around us and minimizing the environmental impact for each garment. And at the same time fulfil our employee promise "We promise you the right to always be yourself - a place to belong”. The Kappahl team consists of some 4,000 colleagues in eight countries, all with different backgrounds, ages, skills and styles. Our common motivation is to create a responsible world of fashion and offer fashion to a wide variety of people and lifestyles. A responsible fashion that feels right, for the bearer and for the world we live in. Today, more than 99% of the products are made of certified or licensed materials. Our overall climate goal is to halve the value chain's absolute climate emissions by 2032 and to have 100% traceability from fibre to finished garment in 2026. We also have a goal that 50% of the range is produced for a circular economy in 2026.

More information at kappahl.com.

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on.
 In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software.
 Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you.
 A stream in the making
 AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner.
 Your mission
 As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas:
  AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc.
 AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing.
  
You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform.
 You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value.
 You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers.
 You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.
Profile description:Your profile
  You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.
 You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work.

You will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.

Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.

AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.

Build to discover, then share what you learn. Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need to

You look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.

We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.

About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research area
Wellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.
A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.
The role
The postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.
The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events.

Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular science

Meritorious
Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text
Development of open research software or openly shared models
Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics

A curriculum vitae

We are looking for one to two professors of Statistics for permanent positions at the School of Business.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Statistics.
Background
Örebro University is seeking one to two professors of Statistics to strengthen and expand our research. Research in the Department of Statistics is mainly focused on Bayesian Statistics with applications in Economics and Finance, as well as Survey Methodology. Formally, and based on a close collaboration, the Departments of Statistics and Economics constitutes a joint research environment with cross-disciplinary research groups in wellbeing and health economics; entrepreneurship, globalization and institutions; macro- and financial econometrics (MAFE) and statistics (stat@oru). In addition, the department benefits from a close collaboration with Statistics Sweden. We are looking for candidates whose expertise can, in particular, strengthen the MAFE and stat@oru groups, and who can also take on a leadership role.
Education in the Department of Statistics spans the bachelor’s, master’s and doctoral levels. In addition to the Bachelor’s Programme in Statistics, courses are offered in, among others, the Programme for Business and Economics. At the master’s level, a two-year study programme in statistics is offered which has been awarded the ‘European Master in Official Statistics’ (EMOS) label by Eurostat. The department also offers courses in the Master’s Programme in Economics and Econometrics, and the Master’s Programme in Finance.
In addition to Statistics and Economics, Örebro University School of Business hosts the departments of Business Administration and Informatics. The Business School is accredited by AACSB, the largest accreditation body and network for business schools globally – an achievement accomplished only by five per cent of the world’s 16,000 business schools.
Duties and responsibilities
As a rule, a professor at Örebro University spends the bulk of their working hours on research. They are also expected to work actively to bring in external research grants to the subject, take overall responsibility for its research activities, and monitor developments within the subject field internationally. A professor is expected to be involved at all three levels of higher education and to communicate and collaborate around their own and the department’s research activities.
A professor is moreover expected, within the scope of their employment, to make themselves available for executive and administrative assignments at the university.
The professorships are aimed at strengthening the research in Statistics. We particularly welcome candidates whose research focuses on Bayesian Statistics, Econometrics, Time Series Analysis and/or Survey Statistics. We are seeking individuals with the vision and potential to drive the development in the subject. As two professors are being recruited, the aim is for the appointments to have complementary research profiles and, taken together, to strengthen the breadth of Statistics at Örebro University across the areas listed above.

The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.
We are looking for an Academic Advisor to join our Guidance and Wellbeing Office (GWO). As an Academic Advisor at SSE, you will work closely with students across our Bachelor and Master programs, providing guidance and support throughout their studies. 
The GWO team consists of two Academic Advisors and one Student Wellbeing Counsellor. Together, the team provides a first point of contact for students who need support related to their studies, their individual educational needs, or challenges that may affect their ability to study. The team also coordinates support for students with specific educational needs. 
As an Academic Advisor, you will: 
Provide individual guidance to students on study-related matters, helping them navigate challenges and make informed decisions about their studies. 
Meet students with a wide range of needs and circumstances and help identify appropriate forms of support. 
Coordinate support for students with specific educational needs and work with relevant colleagues to ensure appropriate arrangements. 
Work closely with the Student Wellbeing Counsellor and the other Academic Advisor to provide coordinated support to students. 
Guide students to other relevant functions or professional support when their needs fall outside the scope of academic advising. 
Collaborate with faculty and other colleagues across SSE on student-related matters. 
Contribute to developing routines, information and ways of working within GWO 
Participate in preventive and student-focused initiatives aimed at creating good conditions for students to succeed in their studies. 

What we offer you
At SSE, you’ll join a small, close-knit GWO team and work across a lively academic community. The role combines one-to-one work with students and collaboration with faculty and colleagues throughout the School. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how GWO supports students, develop its ways of working and contribute to initiatives that strengthen the study experience. It’s a varied role with room to take initiative, build strong working relationships and be part of students’ academic journeys.
About you
You are an attentive, confident communicator who can build trust while maintaining clear professional boundaries. You are comfortable meeting students with varied needs, including in challenging or sensitive situations.
You listen with care, ask thoughtful questions and can work out what kind of guidance or support may be most useful. You are calm and practical when situations are complex, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise. You are also ready to contribute to initiatives that strengthen students’ wellbeing and study experience.
Qualifications
We are looking for someone with:

A Bachelor’s degree in Study and Career Guidance (Swedish: Studie- och yrkesvägledarexamen).

Experience in student support, academic advising, counselling, education or another role involving professional guidance and individual support.

Spoken and written Swedish and English.

Meritorious

Knowledge of educational support for students with disabilities or other specific educational needs.

Experience using Nais and Ladok.

Experience working in higher education.

Other:
This is a full-time, permanent position with an initial six-month probationary period. The position is based in Stockholm and start date is according to agreement.
We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. 
We look forward to receiving your application.

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Hands-on experience of using AI tools in your legal work.

Take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be told what to do.
Enjoy a high pace and stay structured when many matters compete for your time.
Are commercially minded and know how to balance legal risk against business priorities.
Like working close to the business and can make complex questions simple.
Are always looking for smarter ways of working and see AI as a natural part of how legal work gets done.

Benefits

Comprehensive health coverage with extensive health insurance, long-term illness protection, and flexible salary exchange options.
Invest in your wellbeing with an annual wellness allowance of 3,000 SEK to spend on the activities that keep you healthy and energized.
More time to enjoy life with an extra day off when major holidays, such as Christmas Eve or New Year’s Eve, fall on a weekend.
